sloka: ववृषुः पुष्पवर्षाणि तदद्भुतमभूत्तदा।प्रशशंसुर्हते तस्मिन् राक्षसे क्रूरकर्मणि ।। ६.९१.९० ।।
transliteration: vavṛṣuḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi tadadbhutamabhūttadā।praśaśaṁsurhate tasmin rākṣase krūrakarmaṇi ।। 6.91.90 ।।

translations.english: As the terror of all worlds had fallen and the water from the sky became pure, Devas and Danavas rejoiced and came there.
